name: Chile
summary: The Chilean tax authority SII defines generic RUTs with a real meaning: 66.666.666-6 for an anonymous boleta customer and 55.555.555-5 for a foreign receiver without a RUT. Its certification manual uses the "fictitious company" 97975000-5 "RUT DE PRUEBA". None of these can be checked against the register (the SII lookup needs a captcha). Many other SII example RUTs fall in ranges assigned to real people and companies. E-invoices are SII DTE XML, not UBL. Subtel reserves no telephone numbers for fiction, and no official example bank account exists.

identifiers.name: RUT / RUN (Rol Único Tributario / Nacional)
identifiers.format: Body of up to 8 digits + hyphen + check digit (0–9 or K); written 12.345.678-5, or 12345678-5 in DTE XML
identifiers.notes: Mod 11 with weights 2–7 repeating from the right; 11 → 0, 10 → K. Natural persons roughly ≤ 30 million, legal entities ≈ 50–99 million (approximate, not officially verified).

identifiers.name: Código postal
identifiers.format: 7 digits (3-digit sector + 4-digit block-face serial), left of the commune name; commune-wide codes end in 0000
identifiers.notes: DTE XML has no postcode field (DirRecep, CmnaRecep, CiudadRecep are free text).

entries.label: Issuer RUT of the "fictitious company" in the SII certification manual
entries.notes: Best Chilean company ID, but not checkable against the register. The same manual uses SII's own real address (Teatinos 120, Piso 4); do not copy it.
